panel.title: Campaign Adaptation Studio
panel.subtitle: Turn this campaign into a comic or movie package, without touching what actually happened at the table until you say so.
panel.empty: No adaptations yet. Start one to begin the wizard.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this adaptation?
deleteDialog.description: "{{name}}" and everything reviewed inside it will be removed. The campaign itself is never affected.

source.title: Choose your source material
source.description: Pick how this adaptation should read the campaign: what was actually played at the table, what was planned by the GM, or both.

modes.planned: Planned material — GM prep, outlines and lore as written
modes.played: Played material — session chronicles and recaps only
modes.mixed: Mixed — planned material filled in with what was actually played

scope.title: Scope and spoiler policy
scope.description: Decide which part of the campaign to pull from and how much of the GM's secrets should be allowed through.

scopeModes.sessions: A session range or specific chronicles

scope.branchHint: Every descendant of the entries you pick is included.

spoilerPolicies.revealed_only: Revealed only — nothing the players haven't already learned
spoilerPolicies.include_gm_truth: Include GM truth — every secret, for a director's-cut adaptation
spoilerPolicies.custom: Custom — decide item by item during canon review

scope.noEntities: This campaign has no lore entries yet.

scan.title: Scan the campaign
scan.description: Reads the current state of the selected scope and compares it against the last scan, so nothing you've already reviewed is silently overwritten.
scan.noSnapshotYet: This adaptation hasn't been scanned yet.
scan.noDiff: Nothing changed since the last scan.
scan.conflictsDescription: These scenes were changed manually in this adaptation. Re-running the scan will never overwrite them automatically — review each one yourself.

reconstruction.title: Reconstruct facts and scenes
reconstruction.description: Runs the campaign material through reconstruction to draft facts and scenes for review. Nothing here touches campaign canon until you accept it.
reconstruction.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Focus on the harbor arc, keep the tone noir.

timeline.title: Timeline and chronology
timeline.description: Review the reconstructed order of events. Conflicting facts are grouped so you can pick which version belongs in this adaptation.
timeline.conflictsDescription: These facts contradict each other. Resolve them here or in canon review.

canon.title: Canon review
canon.description: Every fact starts as needs review. Accepting a fact only affects this adaptation — applying it to campaign canon is a separate, deliberate step.

applyDialog.title: Apply this fact to campaign canon?
applyDialog.description: This will update "{{name}}"'s description in the campaign itself. Every player and GM will see this change, not just this adaptation.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Match uploaded images and files to the characters, locations and props that will appear in the adaptation.

narrative.title: Narrative settings
narrative.description: Shape the overall voice of the adaptation before generating comic or movie projections.
narrative.povPlaceholder: e.g. Third person, the party as an ensemble
narrative.maxScenesHint: Leave empty to keep every reconstructed scene.

comic.title: Comic settings
comic.description: Configure the comic projection that will be exported for RX Comics.
comic.pageTargetHint: Leave empty to let the story decide the page count.

movie.title: Movie settings
movie.description: Configure the movie projection that will be exported for MovieSmith.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Review these before generating. Nothing here blocks export, but unresolved problems usually mean a weaker result.

checks.noScenes: No scenes have been reconstructed yet.
checks.unresolvedAssets: {{count}} asset(s) are still unresolved or ambiguous.

actions.confirmAllDescription: These were written by the assistant and nobody has read them yet. Confirming marks them all as accepted. Use Fix to read them one by one first.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: Export the adaptation as a package. Each export downloads a ZIP file ready to hand off.
generate.bundleDescription: Everything: facts, scenes, assets and every configured projection.
generate.comicDescription: Only what RX Comics needs to build the issue.
generate.movieDescription: Only what MovieSmith needs to build the movie.
generate.problemsWarning: Finish these before exporting for the best result. You can still export as is.

chronicle.intro: Chronicle sessions in depth: paste or import a transcript, let reconstruction draft findings, then review each one before it ever reaches campaign canon.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this chronicle?
deleteDialog.description: "{{title}}" and everything reviewed inside it will be removed.

chronicle.rawNotesPlaceholder: Freeform notes taken during or after the session.
chronicle.draftDescription: Run reconstruction on the transcript and notes above to draft findings below.
chronicle.approvedRecapPlaceholder: The final recap once you're happy with it — this is what players see.
chronicle.approvedRecapHint: Only what you approve here reaches the recap players see; the reconstruction draft never publishes on its own.
